// diagnostic

E0776

`b.compiler` is called outside the root package's own build source

What

`b.compiler` is called outside the root package's own build source

Why

Only the package being built makes the `Compiler` value; a dependency that receives the root's `Build` gets no compiler control from it

Fix

Call `b.compiler(target)` in the root package's `build: fn` and pass the value to the function that needs it
